# onepassword Provider

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
This documentation is generated from the provider schema.
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_tags` (Block, Optional) Default tags to apply to all items created by this provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--default_tags))
- `desktop_app_integration` (Block, Optional) Configuration for 1Password Desktop App integration. Requires 1Password CLI to be installed and configured. Mutually exclusive with service_account.

Reference: https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/ (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--desktop_app_integration))
- `service_account` (Block, Optional) Configuration for 1Password Service Account authentication. Mutually exclusive with desktop_app_integration.

Reference: https://developer.1password.com/docs/service-accounts/ (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service_account))
